items.question: Do I need to be good with computers?
items.answer: Not at all. If you can send a text or use Facebook, you can use PriceM8. We built it to be dead simple.

items.question: Can I use it on my phone?
items.answer: Yes, PriceM8 works on your phone, tablet and laptop. You can start a quote in the van and finish it at home.

items.question: How accurate are the material prices?
items.answer: We check prices weekly from major UK suppliers. You can also adjust them yourself if you have better local rates.

items.question: Is there a contract?
items.answer: No. You can cancel anytime. We don't believe in locking people in.
